notes.title: 👨‍🔧💡 September Devlog! 🔌⚡
notes.content:
Hello Electric Fans! 🔋
September Milestone is here. Check our video 🎥
[previewyoutube=BjsiCjqqcME;full][/previewyoutube]
💠 Cable system - we have completely redesigned the cable layout - now they have great physics, are flexible, and behave naturally

💠 Distribution box - we have significantly improved it - it supports complex and detailed cable configurations, providing great freedom and accuracy.

💠 Drilling - it has undergone a major update - it creates real holes with depth and texture.

💠 Hole masking - we have improved hole masking, it is very realistic!

💠 The office has been redefined - it is aesthetic and well-designed.

💠 The garage has been designed - this is where every job begins - you pack your tools into a box, get in your vehicle, and drive to the job site!

💠 Computer - for now, you can change cosmetic things in your office, but over time it will have a wealth of functionality!

⤵️⤵️⤵️⤵️⤵️

notes.title: July Milestone! 💡
notes.content:
Hello Electric Fans! 🔋
[previewyoutube=eOzK7uQ3OA0;full][/previewyoutube]
July Milestone is here:
💠 Menu redesign. The option to directly select quests has been removed – instead, we start the game in our own office, which now functions as an interactive HUB.

💠 The office offers various functions and interaction options. We can use the task board to select tasks to complete. New quests will appear as the electrician's reputation grows.

💠 At the beginning, our office is quite modest, but as our career and earnings develop, we will be able to upgrade and decorate it to make it feel like a real workplace.

💠 The HUB also offers tutorials that make it easy to refresh all the basics.

💠 New mechanics for climbing high-voltage poles and other tall objects. This feature will be especially useful in tasks that take place in open spaces.

💠 A shop is also being launched. Before each job, we will receive a shopping list with essential and optional items. The latter can be omitted, but then we risk a lower rating from the customer. In the future, we also want to introduce the option of assigning purchases to an assistant.

💠 We also plan to add an e-waste container where we can collect used equipment and sell it to earn extra cash.

💠 Finally, something a little unusual: drinking influences our character's sobriety. Working under the influence can earn the respect of other electricians and unlock unique perks or tools. But be careful — if a customer catches us red-handed, it's unlikely to end well.


⤵️⤵️⤵️⤵️⤵️

notes.title: First Milestone!🔌📶
notes.content:
💡 Hello electric Fans! 🔋

We are glad that you are interested in our game. It is a priority for us to keep you informed about the progress of our work 🕵 That being said, we can get started!

🥇 Milestone #1

[previewyoutube=EhZUHQM01Z0;full][/previewyoutube]

Changes and progress:

🔹 We have created a full system for saving and loading installations.

🔹 Changing the cable laying system - replacing ObiRope with cylinder-based geometry, which improved performance without sacrificing quality.  

🔹 Adding an animated character model.  

🔹 Introducing the effect of throwing objects out of the player's hands when unfolding items.  

🔹 Design of the new UI.

🔹 Prototype of smart light bulbs that allow changing the color and intensity of light.  

🔹 Prototype of a monitoring system and motion sensor lights.  

🔹 Setting up surveillance cameras to eliminate blind spots.
